value: Purchase price reported as 'slightly over half a million euros' (Pravda)
detail: First listed in the declaration for 2023 (TA3, Pravda) and again for 2024 (TASR). Pravda reports that he bought the flat, which he had rented since 2019, at the end of December 2023 from Smer MP Dušan Muňko, at a price it describes as about half the market value; the foundation Zastavme korupciu questioned how the purchase was financed, and according to Pravda's reading of the land register no mortgage is registered. Fico has said the price is a private matter. Slovak public officials file an annual declaration (oznámenie funkcionára) with the National Council's Committee on Incompatibility of Functions, which publishes it on nrsr.sk; that site was not readable for this research (bot check), so the figures are taken from press reports that cite the declaration.
